params.prompt: Pixel art game background, 16-bit era, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing. Limited 16-colour muted palette: ochre, umber brown, slate blue, brick red, bottle green, cream paper. 1930s rural river town, unspecified country. No people, no text, no letters or words or numbers anywhere, all signs and papers blank. Top-down 3/4 overhead view game map of a whole small town fitting exactly one screen, seen from high above at an angle, in spring daylight. A river runs horizontally across the lower third of the picture with one stone bridge crossing it in the middle. A dirt main street runs left to right above the river. Spread out clearly separated along the street with space between them: a white wooden church with a steeple, a tavern, a general store with an awning, a small post office, a two-storey brick town hall with a flagpole, a small clinic, a one-room schoolhouse with a bell, a narrow newspaper office with a hand press visible through the window. On the riverbank to the right: a large sawmill with smoke and log piles. Along the top edge: a railway line with a small railway station and platform. Top left corner: dark pine woods. Bottom left and bottom right beyond the river: two farmsteads with ploughed fields and a barn each. About eight small cottages scattered between. Clear readable silhouettes for every building, each building distinct in shape and roof colour.
params.name: town_map
